proposal.summary: OpenSC contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package when parsing a malformed ASN.1 package; incorrect remaining-length calculation due to a moved starting pointer can cause OOB read and may crash when built with ASAN, with potential info leak or further impact.
proposal.cwe_quote: This security flaw cause a buffer overrun vulnerability in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package. The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context. The cardos_have_verifyrc_package function scans the ASN1 buffer for 2 tags, where remaining length is wrongly caculated due to moved starting pointer. This leads to possible heap-based buffer oob read.

AV.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

C.quote: Further info leak or more damage is possible.

A.quote: In cases where ASAN is enabled while compiling this causes a crash.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request the vendor or reporter to provide exact affected OpenSC versions/commits, a minimal reproducer or malformed ASN.1 sample, and confirm whether exploitation can occur remotely or requires local access to the smart card; obtain a PoC showing info leak or crash and any mitigation/workaround.
